title: Foldkit's creator goes full-time on Foldkit
summary: Foldkit's creator is now working on the framework full-time, citing the project's momentum. Foldkit began in June 2025 to combine Elm and Effect.

topReplies.text:
I started working on Foldkit in June of 2025. The idea was to bring together Elm and Effect and make the frontend framework of my dreams.

I've spent the vast majority of my free time on the framework since the start of this year. Even when I'm not sitting at my computer or
@devinjameson Congratulations man! Excited to see what more you can bring and do for FoldKit now that you can focus on it full time.

title: Effect Office Hours 52 with Resonate HQ
summary: Office Hours 52 hosts the founder of Resonate HQ, which builds open durable execution: async and await across TypeScript, Python and more.

title: tla-ts 0.0.9 adds TLC's -continue
summary: The TypeScript TLA+ checker now keeps exploring after a violation with -continue, compiles and parses specs faster, and fixes mixed tuple and string unions.

title: tailnet-do
summary: Puts a Cloudflare Durable Object on a Tailscale tailnet as a device with its own address, using Tailscale's userspace client compiled to WebAssembly.

title: Tardigrade 0.55 on Effect 4.1
summary: Durable, event-driven actors for TypeScript; v0.54 moved to Effect 4.1 stable and v0.55 adds remote methods to the client.

title: Foldkit Blocks and Effect Layers preview
summary: A new preview: Blocks are built through Layers, take InMessages and compose their updates, with less child initialization wiring. APIs may change before stable.

title: XState 6 beta and @xstate/effect 1.0 beta
summary: XState v6 enters beta: no more breaking changes planned for @public APIs; snapshot restore moves to restoreActor in xstate/persist.

title: effect-discord-perms
summary: A typed layer over dfx on Effect v4: missing permissions, payload rules and intents become compile errors, each rule checked against live Discord.

title: ns-foldkit runs Foldkit on iOS and Android
summary: Runs Foldkit apps unmodified on iOS and Android with real native views through NativeScript, replacing only the DOM layer with a native bridge.

title: alchemy-turbo-cache
summary: A Turbo remote cache on Cloudflare Workers and R2, declared by an Alchemy Stack: one call declares the Worker, an expiring bucket and per-team tokens.

title: Executor 2 beta
summary: Lets agents call OpenAPI, MCP, GraphQL and custom JavaScript functions in a secure environment; built on Effect, MIT licensed.

title: tsrs --lint replaces Oxlint's type-aware linter, now with Effect rules
summary: tsrs --lint shipped as a drop-in replacement for Oxlint's type-aware tsgolint, and the Effect rules now run in it through a --tsrs-lint flag.

title: kabuki brings a Foldkit-style API to React on Effect
summary: kabuki 0.0.5 maps React components to actors, useReducer to model, message and update, and useEffect to declarative workers; React still renders.

topReplies.text:
I released (v0.0.5). And I am already happy about the results.
Feedback very welcome.

Docs: https://t.co/dzBm58zw2T
Repo: https://t.co/Cefmnf8KkH (packages/kabuki)

Incrementally adoptable.
Can migrate a single component / whole app with it!

The entire https://t.co/3A0eJPX02G is built on kabuki start framework!
End to end kabuki.
With static rendering!

@HANGxue257306 Yes!
Everything in kabuki is declarative.
A worker can live for the lifetime of entire actor, a state or even a specific condition!
We do not start anything imperatively. That is what make it so easy to work with.

title: VibeLang alpha spec
summary: A v0 language for writing Effect programs in TypeScript syntax, with typed errors and services the compiler checks; alpha spec final, release pending.

title: mutant-cafe 0.1.2: mutation testing for Effect TypeScript
summary: Type-directed mutants for Effect code, including one per tagged error that swallows just that error; inspired by cargo-mutants. Install with npm i -D mutant-cafe.

title: Alchemy 2.0.0-beta.85 moves to Effect 4.1
summary: Breaking: Cloudflare.state takes workerName only, DynamoDB becomes the default AWS state, and the state store deploys through direct API calls.

title: Silk: What If Effect Were a Low-Level Language?
summary: A low-level language with Effect-style typed failures, service requirements and lazy effects, affine ownership, and LLVM output for native and WebAssembly targets.

title: Effect fixes the type errors TypeScript 7.1 reports
summary: Merged: TypeScript 7.1 reports errors at five places 7.0.2 accepts; this fixes them without changing any public type signature.

title: 16 new Effect language service rules, also in tsrs and Oxlint
summary: New rules spot Effect boilerplate and rewrite it to builtins such as mapBoth, fromResult and failSync, with quick fixes; they need type-aware linting.

title: What is the aha moment for Foldkit?
summary: Asks for Foldkit's aha moment; replies cite explicit reducer transitions, agent devtools for state inspection, Scene tests, and the Elm Architecture in TypeScript.

topReplies.text: @mattpocockuk Constraints make agents successful. Strict Typing is a fantastic constraint that keeps the agent on rails. You have already seen that with @EffectTS_, @mattpocockuk. @foldkit is exactly that. Architectural constraints.

@mattpocockuk Also @mattpocockuk here’s a cool video of creating a functional core imperative shell demo that renders foldkit logic in n different paradigms and syncs their data (including navigational state) in realtime amongst them: https://t.co/eGnfUbh4TL

@mattpocockuk I'd like to love FoldKit, but the legacy of having an entire company built around React (with a comprehensive design system tightly bound to it) is a deal breaker. Then this popped up in my timeline: https://t.co/U6zfTtczSe. I'd like to dig into it more.

title: Effect Office Hours 51: McpTask for long-running tools
summary: Office Hours clip: a community review of adding McpTask to Effect's MCP support for long-running tools.

title: effect@4.1.2 released
summary: Patch fixes ByteSize decimal units, cluster workflow engine shard and retry faults, McpServer middleware and failure encoding, and cookie selection with HttpApiClient baseUrl.

title: Cause & Effect 10: software engineering in the AI era
summary: A clip from Effect's Cause & Effect podcast, episode 10, with John De Goes on software engineering in the AI era.

title: foldkit-serverfn
summary: Schema-typed server functions and streaming for Foldkit on effect/rpc: Commands call them, Subscriptions consume streams, and server renders run handlers in process.

title: Terrarium v2
summary: Small deterministic agent simulations on Alchemy Domain and Effect, with a run explorer for forking and replaying agent runs.

title: Munch Manor
summary: Open-source pixel zombie shooter built with Foldkit and Effect on Cloudflare: seed-replayable games, server-run co-op on Durable Objects, art drawn in code.

title: admin-OS: one set of typed capabilities for screens and MCP tools
summary: An open-source small-business dashboard on Cloudflare Workers. Every screen and every MCP tool reads and writes through the same typed capabilities.

title: relay-kit: an end-to-end encrypted relay on Workers
summary: A self-hostable relay on Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects. It forwards only ciphertext between a phone and a local service; one command deploys it.

title: Foldkit 0.170.0 moves to Effect 4.1
summary: Foldkit and its companion packages move to Effect 4.1, using effect/crypto SecureRandom for UUIDs; the Node adapter and Vite plugin need Node 22.19.

title: durable-object-migrator moves Durable Object data off Cloudflare
summary: Migrates Durable Object SQLite data to Postgres, files or Rivet Actors without downtime. Ships a library, an agent prompt and Alchemy support.

title: Alchemy adds a Foldkit adapter for Domain Apis
summary: Merged: @alchemy.run/domain/Foldkit turns a Domain Api into Foldkit Commands and Subscriptions, so apps stop hand-writing the client bridge.

title: Foldkit Domains example
summary: A Foldkit example of domain search: the field ships in static HTML, accepts edits before hydration, and runs on the Blocks and Layers preview.

title: rat-stack aligns its tsrs checker pins
summary: rat-stack uses effect-tsrs 0.2.2 with --strict --type-check for TypeScript and Effect diagnostics. Plain tsrs 0.20.0 targets TypeScript 7.1 beta. Patched tsc checks parity on checker bumps. effect-tsrs 0.2.2 needs `--type-check` to report ordinary TypeScript errors.

title: tla-ts
summary: A TLA+ interpreter and model checker in TypeScript that runs in Node or the browser; 0.0.8 shipped on 2026-11-05.

title: mailswitch
summary: A transactional email library for Cloudflare Workers with one API over Resend, Postmark, Amazon SES and SMTP; providers switch without a redeploy.

title: diffinery
summary: An agent-first GitHub and GitHub Actions alternative that runs on your own Cloudflare account: git hosting, pull requests and code review. Apache-2.0.

title: Hillclimbing distilled
summary: An agent optimized distilled, Alchemy's Effect cloud SDKs: 33% smaller bundles, 79% less latency per call and 74% less memory on import.

title: effect-tsrs runs Effect diagnostics on tsrs
summary: rat-stack type-checks with effect-tsrs 0.2.0 in strict mode, so Effect warnings fail. Patched tsc remains a separate CI backstop.

title: tsrs joins the stack as the fast typecheck
summary: rat-stack adds tsrs for fast typechecks. It does not run Effect diagnostics, so patched tsc stays in the gate.

title: effect-email
summary: Effect-native transactional email: typed messages, durable delivery, providers and policies, SMTP, an HTTP gateway and workflows. MIT.

title: @effect/tsgo 0.56.0 released
summary: Effect language service for tsgo now builds, tests and ships against the TypeScript beta channel, currently the 7.1.0 beta compiler.

title: Potion Calendar
summary: A clean-room Google Calendar app built with Effect 4, Alchemy and Foldkit on Cloudflare Workers.

title: skin
summary: An app that rewrites its own code as you use it: Pi Durable builds each change in a Worker Loader isolate and checks it first.

title: hark
summary: A voice agent on your own Cloudflare account: Workers AI for thinking, Deepgram and Aura for speech, with an Effect 4 and Foldkit UI.

title: Maple Alchemy provider
summary: Maple, an open source OpenTelemetry platform built on Effect, ships Alchemy resources for telemetry collection, alerts and dashboards.

title: coil
summary: A deployable showcase: Pi Durable and a Cloudflare Container share one Durable Object per thread, with an Effect 4 and Foldkit UI on Workers.
Cloudflare's Workers docs now cover Foldkit: start with create-foldkit-app, then configure Wrangler for single-page, static or server-rendered apps on Workers Assets.
title: Foldkit framework guide in Cloudflare Workers docs
Alchemy 2.0.0-beta.83: the Cloudflare Birthday Week release
summary: Adds DO containers, K2 streams, Basin and KV Instant. Needs Node 24.11.1+. One-way: once deployed, Durable Object stacks can't use older Alchemy.

title: HumanLayer Channels
summary: Puts agents in Slack, GitHub and Linear without losing a message: durable, ordered webhook mailboxes on Effect 4, with Durable Objects storage through Alchemy.

title: A Foldkit Scene test for the Foldkit UI Toast
summary: Walks through a Scene that swipes a toast a short way and checks it settles back instead of dismissing.
